model.name: EfficientNet-B4
model.trained_on: DeepFakeFace + a face-cropped subset of the OpenFake train split (74 generators)

score_semantics: fake_probability is the detector's softmax probability for the MANIPULATED class (for videos: its mean over frames with a usable face). confidence is the probability of the predicted class. Neither is calibrated, neither is forensic certainty, and neither is the probability that the media is actually manipulated. Suggested wording: 'The detector assigned a fake-class probability of 0.91.'

warnings.message: No face was detected; the detector only analyses face crops, so no prediction was made.

limitations: Trained on DeepFakeFace (Stable Diffusion fakes, InsightFace face swaps) and a face-cropped subset of OpenFake (74 diffusion and transformer image and video generators).

On held-out OpenFake generators (sample of 1,300 images, only 90 real) ROC-AUC was 0.82, recall 68% and false-positive rate 17%; some generators (for example flux-2-klein-9b, 33% recall) are mostly missed.
On StyleGAN-generated faces versus real FFHQ photos (5,045 images) ROC-AUC was 0.49, i.e. chance: GAN-generated faces are not detected.
Confidence is the softmax probability of the predicted class (uncalibrated). It is not forensic certainty and not the probability that the image is actually manipulated.
Only the largest detected face is analysed; images without a detectable face receive no prediction.

Suspicious regions are model-indicated regions from Grad-CAM on a 12x12 feature grid (about 32 px per cell of the 380 px face crop); they are not ground-truth manipulated pixels. Localization accuracy is not yet measured (no manipulation masks are available).
A small set of controlled perturbations; it does not cover all real-world distortion, and results on a few images do not generalise.

The Evidence Stability Score is a project-defined summary of how the evidence held up under a small set of controlled perturbations. It is not a probability that the image is manipulated; the weights and bands are design choices, not calibrated.
No face was detected, so the detector made no prediction and no forensic checks were run.
